title: All-atom molecular dynamics simulation of Cyclophilin A in complex with Sanglifehrin A.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟研究亲环蛋白A与抑制剂Sanglifehrin A复合物的构象动态和结合自由能，属于蛋白质-配体复合物的结构计算研究，方法上使用MD模拟，与本课题的蛋白质结构计算方向高度相关。
abstract: Cyclophilin A (CypA), a key peptidyl-prolyl cis/trans isomerase, plays a pivotal role in various biological processes and is a target for therapeutic intervention, particularly in viral and cancer-related diseases. This study explores the structural and dynamic effects of Sanglifehrin A (SangfA), a potent CypA inhibitor, using molecular dynamics (MD) simulation. All-atom MD simulations (100 ns) of apo CypA and its complex with SangfA were performed using GROMACS v2023. In addition to MD analyses, essential dynamics, clustering, secondary structure, and binding free energy were analyzed. SangfA binding induces a dual dynamic response: local rigidification of the active-site beta2-beta3 loop, residues 100-102 and 108-111 with a coil‑to‑beta-strand transition (beta-sheet content rises from 28.0% to 32.3%), alongside enhanced mobility in distal loops and a 1.1‑fold expansion of the conformational ensemble. Principal component analysis shows redistribution of motions from a single dominant mode (apo PC1 = 44.2%) to more diffuse fluctuations (holo PC1 = 30.4%), increasing configurational entropy. The ligand forms a dynamic hydrogen‑bond network (1-2 persistent bonds) anchored by Arg55 and hydrophobic contacts with Phe60 and Lys105, while Arg55 remains uninvolved. The computed binding free energy (DeltaG = -20.45 +/- 3.07 Kcal/mol) accords with picomolar potency. SangfA acts via conformational selection, stabilizing a pre‑existing CypA substate with augmented beta-structure and broader dynamics. This entropically driven mechanism challenges static inhibition paradigms. Future efforts should validate the beta2-beta3 loop transition experimentally and exploit the Lys105 contact to design next‑generation cyclophilin inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 亲环蛋白A（Cyclophilin A, CypA）是一种关键的肽基脯氨酰顺反异构酶，在多种生物过程中发挥重要作用，并且是治疗干预的靶点，尤其在病毒和癌症相关疾病中。本研究利用分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，探讨了强效CypA抑制剂Sanglifehrin A（SangfA）的结构和动态效应。使用GROMACS v2023对apo CypA及其与SangfA的复合物进行了全原子MD模拟（100 ns）。除MD分析外，还分析了本质动力学、聚类、二级结构和结合自由能。SangfA结合诱导双重动态响应：活性位点beta2-beta3环的局部刚性化，残基100-102和108-111发生卷曲至β-折叠转变（β-折叠含量从28.0%升至32.3%），同时远端环的流动性增强，构象集合扩大1.1倍。主成分分析显示，运动从单一主导模式（apo PC1 = 44.2%）重新分布为更弥散的波动（holo PC1 = 30.4%），增加了构象熵。配体形成由Arg55锚定的动态氢键网络（1-2个持久键）以及与Phe60和Lys105的疏水接触，而Arg55未参与其中。计算的结合自由能（DeltaG = -20.45 +/- 3.07 Kcal/mol）与皮摩尔级效力一致。SangfA通过构象选择发挥作用，稳定了CypA预先存在的亚态，该亚态具有增强的β结构和更广泛的动态性。这种熵驱动的机制挑战了静态抑制范式。未来工作应通过实验验证beta2-beta3环转变，并利用Lys105接触来设计下一代亲环蛋白抑制剂。
